defects.title: Do not infer `number` for a conditional bigint operand.
defects.bug: Unary minus/bitwise-not on a conditional type resolving to bigint is inferred as number.

defects.title: Preserve conditional members in object rest types.
defects.bug: Object rest destructuring of a conditional-typed value yields an empty object type because the conditional is skipped.

defects.title: Do not discard conditional union members when indexing.
defects.bug: Indexing a tuple union drops members that are conditional types, giving too narrow an element type.

defects.title: Preserve nullish results from conditional types.
defects.bug: Optional chaining on a union with a conditional null member omits undefined from the result type.

defects.title: Your import breaks the build: three global IDs do not exist
defects.bug: Imports three global type IDs that do not exist in the generated ids module, breaking compilation.

defects.title: Reject `TwValueThemeReference` here.
defects.bug: Tailwind theme-reference custom properties have no identifier text, so is_none_or accepts them and forces compound-list layout.

defects.title: Mark the package incomplete when you drop an integration at the maximum depth.
defects.bug: Integrations dropped at max nesting depth are not recorded as incomplete, so consumers emit false positives.

defects.title: Keep a parent alternation when its only comma is nested.
defects.bug: For {{js,ts}} the outer braces are escaped because only the inner pair records a comma, so the glob matches wrong names.

defects.title: Treat legacy SCSS `if()` as dynamic.
defects.bug: Legacy SCSS if() is treated as static, so the shorthand-merge fix can change semantics when a branch yields null.

defects.title: 🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win
defects.bug: CSS if() is treated as static though it can expand to multiple values, so the split autofix changes meaning.

defects.title: Exclude same-element slot parameters from default-value references.
defects.bug: A v-for default value resolves names against the same element's v-slot parameters, which are not in scope there.

defects.title: 🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win
defects.bug: Parenthesis check stops at a type assertion, so the formatter drops required parens around an instantiation expression before +.

defects.title: Isolate each plugin-error listener so one throw cannot abort reload or signal cleanup.
defects.bug: A throwing plugin-error listener aborts the loop and propagates, skipping reload notification and provider cleanup.

defects.title: Pass the latest committed mapping to each processor.
defects.bug: Each processor receives the original model-output mapping instead of the previous processor's committed one, undoing earlier edits.

defects.title: Detect raw-result changes by content, not by object identity.
defects.bug: Result change detection uses object identity, so a processor that mutates the result in place leaves the stale mapping in use.

defects.title: Release ownership on every pre-dispatch failure.
defects.bug: A failure between acquiring run ownership and starting execution never releases the lease, leaving renewal running.

defects.title: Match the next green run on the same repository and pull request.
defects.bug: The next green run is matched only by workflow and branch name, so a fork run with the same branch name can be selected.

defects.title: Keep pull-request runs from a fork's `main` branch.
defects.bug: Filtering out head_branch main drops every run of PRs opened from a fork's main branch.

defects.title: Do not report “none connected” when a check failed.
defects.bug: Summary says none connected even when an integration check failed and its status is unknown.

defects.title: Release the acquired lease if the snapshot read fails.
defects.bug: If loading the workflow snapshot throws, the acquired resume lease is never released, blocking recovery until expiry.

defects.title: Reject blank project names passed with `--name`.
defects.bug: A blank or whitespace --name bypasses validation and creates a whitespace directory or targets the current directory.

defects.title: Keep head updates unsettled until their card can record the head.
defects.bug: A merge-request head update with no card yet is reported settled, so discovery never retries recording that head.

defects.title: Keep follow-ups past the fifth page reachable across sweeps.
defects.bug: Each sweep restarts at page one with a five-page cap, so follow-ups beyond page five are never ingested.

defects.title: Check the child run's own lease in standalone restart.
defects.bug: Standalone restart of a nested child run gets a no-op lease, so it can overlap a concurrent resume of the same run.

defects.title: Queued cards can lose their position when the board decision page is full.
defects.bug: Card queue position comes from a newest-50 decisions page, so older queued waiters get no position.

defects.title: Keep a changed search field editable when its value is empty.
defects.bug: A text-search chip with an empty value is dropped by a truthiness check before the user can type into it.

defects.title: Include singleton cards in the board-before-source lock order.
defects.bug: Skipping the board lock for single-card groups inverts lock order against another path, causing deadlocks.

defects.title: Linked cards miss their own rule evaluation when the source was first observed unbound.
defects.bug: A stored ingress result with null itemId makes every later-linked card share the base identity, so its rules never run.

defects.title: Guard the renamed-issue fallback when the card has no external source.
defects.bug: A renamed card without an external source looks up key undefined, matching every sourceless card and running rules on them.

defects.title: Give the authoring card's two `pullRequestOpened` evaluations distinct ingress identities.
defects.bug: Primary and companion pullRequestOpened evaluations get the same ingress id, so the companion is treated as a replay.

defects.title: Evaluate the companion's source-sharing cards too.
defects.bug: Merge evaluation only expands the issue's source, so cards linked to the PR's source never get evaluated.

defects.title: Keep caching disabled until the subscription is ready.
defects.bug: Repository caching is enabled before the change subscription is ready, so announcements can be missed and the cache goes stale.

defects.title: Report skipped cards instead of unconditional success.
defects.bug: Bulk move reports success and discards the skipped count even when cards were skipped.

defects.title: Discard stale reroute previews, and clear the warning when the latest preview is empty.
defects.bug: Concurrent reroute previews can finish out of order and show stale counts; an empty latest preview leaves the old warning.

defects.title: Pass the request context to the handler's FGA check.
defects.bug: Handler-level FGA check omits the request context that route-level check passes, so providers can wrongly deny.

defects.title: Bound snapshot results without losing cursor progress.
defects.bug: The since-cursor comment query has no row limit and can exceed the output buffer, failing every poll forever.

defects.title: Named `toolChoice` keeps the old tool name after the web search rename.
defects.bug: Renaming the web search tool leaves a named toolChoice pointing at a tool name absent from the tools list.

defects.title: **Cancelled waits consume budget**
defects.bug: Cancelling during the queue wait keeps the reserved input cost although no provider call was made.

defects.title: *Resolved in [`39e30df`](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/commit/39e30dfedf276d86c4052b44417670aedf409fef)*
defects.bug: During rolling deploy, writes via old instances desync the new column from the old one if the flag flips early.
